title.zh-TW: 終止子代理與刪除對話自動清除孤立工作樹，釋放磁碟空間
title.zh-CN: 终止子代理与删除对话自动清理孤立工作树，释放磁盘空间
title.en: Terminating subagents and deleting conversations now cleans up orphaned Git worktrees to free disk space
title.ja: サブエージェントの強制終了や会話削除時に孤立ワークツリーを自動削除し、ディスク容量を解放
title.ko: 서브에이전트 종료 및 대화 삭제 시 고립된 워크트리 자동 정리, 디스크 공간 확보

body.zh-TW: 結束多代理協作或清理舊對話時，硬碟不再默默累積暫存資料夾。⟦如同工坊在學徒收工或專案結案時，自動將臨時搭建的平行副工作台拆卸清理，不再讓廢棄支架堆滿倉庫角落。⟧系統在呼叫子代理進行平行作業時，會於 `.system_generated/worktrees` 目錄下建立 worktree（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。過去在強制終止子代理或刪除歷史對話時，這些臨時工作樹常未被完全移除而變成孤立殘留檔案。現在清理機制已修正，會在結束時確實移除並釋放磁碟空間。
body.zh-CN: 结束多代理协作或清理旧对话时，硬盘不再默默积累临时文件夹。⟦如同工坊在学徒收工或项目结案时，自动将临时搭建的平行副工作台拆卸清理，不再让废弃支架堆满仓库角落。⟧系统在调用子代理进行平行作业时，会在 `.system_generated/worktrees` 目录下建立 worktree（Git 让同一项目平行开多份副本的功能）。过去在强制终止子代理或删除历史对话时，这些临时工作树常未被完全移除而变成孤立残留文件。现在清理机制已修正，会在结束时切实移除并释放磁盘空间。
body.en: Ending multi-agent collaboration or cleaning up old conversations no longer silently accumulates temporary folders on disk. ⟦Like a workshop automatically dismantling and clearing out temporary parallel workstations when apprentices pack up or projects wrap up, preventing discarded frames from piling up in warehouse corners.⟧ When calling subagents for parallel execution, the system creates worktrees (a Git feature that creates multiple parallel copies of the same project) under the `.system_generated/worktrees` directory. Previously, when forcefully terminating subagents or deleting conversation history, these temporary worktrees were often not fully removed, leaving behind orphaned lingering files. The cleanup mechanism is now fixed to reliably remove them upon completion and reclaim disk space.
body.ja: 複数エージェントによる協調作業の終了時や過去の会話を整理する際、ディスクに一時フォルダが無駄に蓄積されなくなった。⟦工房で見習いが作業を終えたりプロジェクトが完了したりした際に、臨時に組んだ並行作業台を自動で解体・清掃し、不要な支柱が倉庫の隅に山積みになるのを防ぐのと同じである。⟧システムがサブエージェントを呼び出して並行作業を行う際、`.system_generated/worktrees`ディレクトリ配下にworktree（Gitで同一プロジェクトの複数コピーを並行して開く機能）を作成する。従来はサブエージェントを強制終了したり履歴会話を削除したりした際、これらの一時ワークツリーが完全に削除されず孤立した残存ファイルとして残ることがあった。クリーンアップ処理が修正され、終了時に確実に削除されてディスク容量が解放されるようになった。
body.ko: 멀티 에이전트 협업을 마치거나 이전 대화를 정리할 때 디스크에 임시 폴더가 무분별하게 쌓이지 않는다. ⟦공방에서 수습생이 퇴근하거나 프로젝트가 끝났을 때 임시로 설치했던 병렬 보조 작업대를 자동으로 해체 및 정리하여 폐기된 프레임이 창고 구석에 쌓이지 않도록 하는 것과 같다.⟧ 시스템은 서브에이전트를 호출해 병렬 작업을 수행할 때 `.system_generated/worktrees` 디렉터리 아래에 worktree(Git에서 동일 프로젝트의 복사본을 여러 개 병렬로 생성하는 기능)를 생성한다. 이전에는 서브에이전트를 강제 종료하거나 대화 기록을 삭제할 때 이러한 임시 워크트리가 완전히 삭제되지 않아 고립된 잔여 파일로 남곤 했다. 이제 정리 메커니즘이 수정되어 종료 시 확실히 제거되고 디스크 공간을 확보한다.

title.zh-TW: 改善登出速度並落盤中繼資料，排除暫存目錄虛假日誌
title.zh-CN: 优化注销速度并落盘元数据，排除临时目录虚假日志
title.en: Faster `/logout`, metadata flushed to disk on exit, and spurious logs eliminated for temporary directories
title.ja: ログアウト速度の向上とメタデータのディスク書き込み、一時ディレクトリでの不要なエラーログを排除
title.ko: 로그아웃 속도 개선 및 메타데이터 디스크 저장 보장, 임시 디렉터리 허위 오류 로그 제거

body.zh-TW: 在登出帳號、結束指令與載入自訂設定時，底層的狀態處理與儲存機制進行了一批強化。使用 `/logout` 登出時，若系統金鑰圈被繞過或無法連線，系統會直接捷徑刪除檔案中的 token（授權令牌），縮短登出耗費的時間。在離開命令列介面時，系統修復了 SQLite 資料庫的預寫日誌檢查點機制，確保關閉前將最後的工作階段中繼資料完整寫入硬碟。此外，自訂功能探索機制在存取暫存目錄或工作區以外的路徑時，也不會再印出多餘的虛假錯誤日誌。⟦猶如劇院散場後的後台收尾：工作人員先把道具登記入庫，再確認燈控系統完整歸零存檔，最後閘門落鎖，不再對後台外的公共走廊誤觸警報。⟧
body.zh-CN: 在注销账号、退出命令与加载自定义配置时，底层的状态处理与存储机制完成了一批强化。使用 `/logout` 注销时，若系统密钥环被绕过或无法连接，系统会直接快捷删除文件中的 token（授权令牌），缩短注销耗费的时间。在退出命令行界面时，系统修复了 SQLite 数据库的预写日志检查点机制，确保关闭前将最后的会话元数据完整写入硬盘。此外，自定义功能发现机制在访问临时目录或工作区以外的路径时，也不会再打印多余的虚假错误日志。⟦犹如剧院散场后的后台收尾：工作人员先把道具登记入库，再确认灯控系统完整归零存档，最后闸门落锁，不再对后台外的公共走廊误触发警报。⟧
body.en: Underlying state handling and persistence mechanisms have received a batch of enhancements during account logout, command exits, and customization loading. When logging out via `/logout`, if the system keyring is bypassed or unreachable, the system now short-circuits token removal directly to file storage, speeding up logout execution. When exiting the command-line interface, the system fixes SQLite database WAL checkpointing to ensure trailing session metadata is fully flushed to disk before shutdown. Furthermore, customization discovery no longer logs spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace. ⟦Like backstage wrap-up after a theater show ends: staff first register props into storage, verify the lighting control system is fully reset and saved, and finally lock the gates without accidentally triggering alarms for public corridors outside the backstage area.⟧
body.ja: アカウントのログアウト時、コマンド終了時、およびカスタム設定の読み込み時における、低レベルの状態処理とストレージ機構が一連の強化を受けた。`/logout`でログアウトする際、システムのキーリングがバイパスされているかアクセス不能な場合、システムはファイルストレージから直接token（認証トークン）をショートカット削除してログアウトにかかる時間を短縮する。コマンドラインインターフェースの終了時、SQLiteデータベースのWALチェックポイント処理が修正され、シャットダウン前にセッションの最終メタデータがディスクへ完全に書き込まれるようになった。さらに、カスタム機能の探索処理が一時ディレクトリやアクティブなワークスペース外のパスにアクセスする際、余計な虚偽のエラーログを出力しなくなった。⟦劇場の終演後に行う舞台裏の片付けのように、スタッフがまず小道具を入庫登録し、調光システムが完全にリセットされて保存されたことを確認したうえで最後に施錠し、楽屋裏の外にある共用通路に対して警報を誤作動させないようにするのと同じである。⟧
body.ko: 계정 로그아웃, 명령어 종료, 사용자 정의 설정 로드 시 하위 상태 처리 및 스토리지 메커니즘이 대폭 강화되었다. `/logout`으로 로그아웃할 때 시스템 키링이 우회되었거나 연결할 수 없는 경우, 시스템은 파일 스토리지에서 token(인증 토큰)을 직접 즉시 삭제하여 로그아웃 소요 시간을 단축한다. 명령줄 인터페이스를 종료할 때 SQLite 데이터베이스의 WAL 체크포인트 메커니즘이 수정되어, 종료 전에 마지막 세션 메타데이터가 디스크에 온전히 기록되도록 보장한다. 또한 사용자 정의 기능 탐색 메커니즘이 임시 디렉터리나 활성 워크스페이스 외부 경로에 접근할 때 불필요한 허위 오류 로그를 더 이상 출력하지 않는다. ⟦공연이 끝난 극장의 백스테이지 정리 작업처럼, 직원이 먼저 소품을 입고 등록하고 조명 제어 시스템이 완전히 초기화되어 저장된 것을 확인한 뒤 문을 잠금으로써 백스테이지 밖의 공용 복도에 오경보를 울리지 않게 하는 것과 같다.⟧

items.original:
Improved `/logout` execution time by short-circuiting token removal directly to file storage when keyring storage is bypassed or unreachable.
Fixed SQLite database WAL checkpointing on CLI exit so trailing session metadata updates are flushed to disk before shutdown.
Fixed customization discovery logging spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace.

entries: **Self-heal no longer takes over a user's own script that merely shares part of a hook's filename.** Both the hook-removal path and the migration path that keeps an installed hook's command current used a plain substring check against markers like `usage-terse-mode`, so a user's own script — say, a backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py` — matched and was silently rewritten to the official command. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`; the same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.

**Language detection no longer misreads plain English words as Japanese or Korean, or a made-up Chinese-script tag as a real one.** The `_normalize_lang` logic — duplicated across four files — matched `ja`/`ko` with an unbounded `startswith`, so `jargon` and `koala` were read as Japanese and Korean; a POSIX `@modifier` suffix wasn't stripped, so `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English; and `zh-HK` didn't accept further BCP 47 subtags the way `zh-TW`/`zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant`/`zh-Hans` (letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese) and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix (dropping a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` tag to English). All four duplicated copies now require a boundary after every prefix.

**A non-UTF-8 terminal no longer crashes terse mode or session resume, and a truncated or corrupted version marker no longer wedges self-heal.** The SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks wrote JSON without `ensure_ascii`, so a terminal using an encoding like cp950 raised `UnicodeEncodeError` and lost the entire message; output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. The four version-marker readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, which meant a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. Separately, a stale terse-mode sidecar whose content had rotted was never rebuilt as long as the hook version hadn't changed, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it's now checked by validating the sidecar's content.

**Session resume's stdin and stdout failures are handled the same way its sibling hooks already were, and a corrupted newest session log falls back to an older one instead of going silent.** `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe, and unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume didn't catch it — an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. Separately, `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt disappear instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did.

**The health-check reminder's own state write no longer takes the whole resume prompt down with it, a bare punctuation reply is no longer read as a real request, and a newly created but uncommitted directory now shows up in the "not saved yet" list.** Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` (a full disk, a permissions error) and that exception propagated out far enough to swallow the main resume prompt along with it; it's now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. Separately, `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary.

**A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done.** The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored, and the next session's resume prompt kept reporting work that was already finished.

**The quota-restored notification fires again, and a warning now fires on the very first reading if quota is already past the threshold.** Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation, and the restored notification never fired. It's now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — for instance, the app launching mid-session at 95% — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.

**A dead plist key was removed, and a Windows registry read failure can no longer take down the whole tray menu.** `StartDelay` isn't a key `launchd.plist(5)` recognizes, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added; it's gone. Separately, the Windows login-item's `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`, but it's called once per menu render to draw the "launch at login" checkbox — a registry permission error there propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled."

**Terse mode's plain-language rule now also covers text pasted verbatim from a subagent.** The mode's own prompt only governed sentences Claude wrote itself, leaving no instruction for handling a subagent's report or a tool's raw output when quoted directly — jargon inside it went unexplained. A line was added after the existing "explain a term on first use" rule, in all five languages.

title.zh-TW: 自癒不再把名字像的自製腳本改成官方指令
title.zh-CN: 自愈不再把名字像的自制脚本改成官方命令
title.en: Self-heal stops taking over your own script that just looks like a hook
title.ja: 自己修復が名前の似た自作スクリプトを乗っ取らなくなる
title.ko: 자가 복구가 이름만 비슷한 자작 스크립트를 덮어쓰지 않는다

body.zh-TW: ⟦郵差看到門牌上有「三號」兩個字就把信投進去，結果那是「二十三號」；現在他會確認整個門牌號碼相符才投。⟧你自己留了一份備份檔叫 `usage-terse-mode-backup.py`，`usage` 的自癒功能卻把它認成自家的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），悄悄改寫成官方指令。原因是它只拿 `usage-terse-mode` 這串字去比對，名字含這幾個字就算數。移除那條路徑先修好，要求這串字前後得是路徑分隔符號、引號、空白或字串邊界，並且結尾是 `.py`。現在遷移邏輯裡另外四處判斷要不要覆蓋掛鉤指令的地方，也都改用同一套嚴格比對。
body.zh-CN: ⟦邮差看到门牌上有「三号」两个字就把信投进去，结果那是「二十三号」；现在他会确认整个门牌号码相符才投。⟧你自己留了一份备份文件叫 `usage-terse-mode-backup.py`，`usage` 的自愈功能却把它认成自家的挂钩（hook，特定事件发生时被触发的小程序），悄悄改写成官方命令。原因是它只拿 `usage-terse-mode` 这串字去比对，名字含这几个字就算数。移除那条路径先修好，要求这串字前后得是路径分隔符号、引号、空白或字符串边界，并且结尾是 `.py`。现在迁移逻辑里另外四处判断要不要覆盖挂钩命令的地方，也都改用同一套严格比对。
body.en: ⟦A postman drops the letter off because the plate contains "3", when the address is "23"; now he checks that the whole number matches before posting it.⟧ You keep your own backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py`, and `usage`'s self-heal treated it as one of its own hooks and silently rewrote it to the official command. The cause was a plain substring check against a marker like `usage-terse-mode`: any filename containing those characters counted. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`. The same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.
body.ja: ⟦郵便配達が表札に「3」とあるだけで投函してしまうが、実際の住所は「23」だった。今は番地全体が一致することを確かめてから入れる。⟧自分で `usage-terse-mode-backup.py` というバックアップを置いていると、`usage` の自己修復がそれを自前のフック（特定の出来事で起動する小さなプログラム）と見なし、黙って公式のコマンドに書き換えていた。原因は `usage-terse-mode` という目印を単純な部分一致で調べていたことにある。ファイル名にその文字が含まれるだけで該当と判定されていた。削除の経路が先に修正され、目印の前後がパス区切り、引用符、空白、文字列の端のいずれかであり、末尾が `.py` であることを求めるようになった。移行処理の中でフックのコマンドを上書きするか判断する残り四か所も、今は同じ厳密な判定を使う。
body.ko: ⟦집배원이 문패에 「3」이 있다는 이유로 편지를 넣지만 실제 주소는 「23」이었다. 이제는 번지 전체가 맞는지 확인한 뒤에 넣는다.⟧직접 만들어 둔 `usage-terse-mode-backup.py`라는 백업 파일을 `usage`의 자가 복구가 자기 훅(특정 사건이 일어날 때 실행되는 작은 프로그램)으로 여겨 조용히 공식 명령으로 덮어썼다. 원인은 `usage-terse-mode`라는 표식을 단순 부분 일치로만 검사한 데 있다. 파일 이름에 그 글자가 들어 있기만 하면 해당된다고 판정했다. 제거 경로가 먼저 고쳐져, 표식 앞뒤가 경로 구분자, 따옴표, 공백, 문자열 경계 중 하나이고 끝이 `.py`여야 한다고 요구한다. 훅 명령을 덮어쓸지 판단하는 이관 로직의 나머지 네 군데도 이제 같은 엄격한 검사를 쓴다.

items.original: **Self-heal no longer takes over a user's own script that merely shares part of a hook's filename.** Both the hook-removal path and the migration path that keeps an installed hook's command current used a plain substring check against markers like `usage-terse-mode`, so a user's own script — say, a backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py` — matched and was silently rewritten to the official command. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`; the same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.

title.zh-TW: 英文單字不再被當成日文或韓文
title.zh-CN: 英文单词不再被当成日文或韩文
title.en: Plain English words are no longer read as Japanese or Korean
title.ja: 英単語が日本語や韓国語と誤読されなくなる
title.ko: 영어 단어가 일본어나 한국어로 잘못 읽히지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 語言代碼是拿來標示介面該講哪種語言的短代號，`ja` 是日文、`ko` 是韓文。`usage` 判斷代碼時只看開頭幾個字母就算數，於是 `jargon` 被讀成日文、`koala` 被讀成韓文。另外幾種寫法也判錯：`zh_TW@variant` 因為沒有先去掉 `@` 後面那段而掉回英文；`zh-HK` 不像 `zh-TW` 那樣接受後面再加細分代碼。再查一輪還發現 `zh-Hant` 和 `zh-Hans` 有同樣的開頭比對問題，亂編的 `zh-Hantasy` 也會被當成繁體中文，而缺了 `zh-SG-` 這個開頭讓合法的 `zh-SG-x-private` 掉成英文。這段判斷在四個檔案裡各有一份，現在四份都要求開頭之後有明確邊界。⟦查字典時只憑前兩個字母就翻到某一頁，`jar` 開頭的字全被歸進同一欄；現在得把整個詞對完才算。⟧
body.zh-CN: 语言代码是拿来标示界面该讲哪种语言的短代号，`ja` 是日文、`ko` 是韩文。`usage` 判断代码时只看开头几个字母就算数，于是 `jargon` 被读成日文、`koala` 被读成韩文。另外几种写法也判错：`zh_TW@variant` 因为没有先去掉 `@` 后面那段而掉回英文；`zh-HK` 不像 `zh-TW` 那样接受后面再加细分代码。再查一轮还发现 `zh-Hant` 和 `zh-Hans` 有同样的开头比对问题，乱编的 `zh-Hantasy` 也会被当成繁体中文，而缺了 `zh-SG-` 这个开头让合法的 `zh-SG-x-private` 掉成英文。这段判断在四个文件里各有一份，现在四份都要求开头之后有明确边界。⟦查字典时只凭前两个字母就翻到某一页，`jar` 开头的字全被归进同一栏；现在得把整个词对完才算。⟧
body.en: A language code is the short tag that says which language the interface should speak: `ja` for Japanese, `ko` for Korean. `usage` matched those with an unbounded prefix test, so `jargon` was read as Japanese and `koala` as Korean. Other forms were misread too: `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English because the part after `@` was not stripped, and `zh-HK` did not accept further subtags the way `zh-TW` and `zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant` and `zh-Hans`, letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese, and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix that dropped a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` to English. This logic was duplicated across four files; all four now require a boundary after every prefix. ⟦Looking a word up by its first two letters alone files everything starting with "jar" in one column; now the whole word has to match.⟧
body.ja: 言語コードとは、画面をどの言語で表示するかを示す短い記号である。`ja` は日本語、`ko` は韓国語を指す。`usage` は先頭の数文字が一致すれば該当と判定していたため、`jargon` が日本語、`koala` が韓国語と読まれていた。他の書き方も誤判定していた。`zh_TW@variant` は `@` 以降を先に取り除かないため英語へ落ち、`zh-HK` は `zh-TW` のように後ろへ細分の記号を足した形を受け付けなかった。追加調査で `zh-Hant` と `zh-Hans` にも同じ先頭一致の不具合が見つかり、でたらめな `zh-Hantasy` まで繁体字中国語と判定されていた。さらに `zh-SG-` の前置きが抜けており、正当な `zh-SG-x-private` が英語へ落ちていた。この判定は四つのファイルに重複しており、今はすべてが前置きの直後に明確な区切りを求める。⟦辞書を最初の二文字だけで引くと、`jar` で始まる語が同じ欄にまとめられてしまう。今は語全体を照合する。⟧
body.ko: 언어 코드는 화면을 어느 언어로 보여 줄지 나타내는 짧은 기호다. `ja`는 일본어, `ko`는 한국어를 가리킨다. `usage`는 앞 몇 글자만 맞으면 해당된다고 판정해서 `jargon`이 일본어로, `koala`가 한국어로 읽혔다. 다른 표기도 잘못 읽혔다. `zh_TW@variant`는 `@` 뒤를 먼저 떼어 내지 않아 영어로 떨어졌고, `zh-HK`는 `zh-TW`처럼 뒤에 세부 기호를 더 붙인 형태를 받아들이지 못했다. 다시 살펴보니 `zh-Hant`와 `zh-Hans`에도 같은 앞자리 일치 문제가 있어 엉터리인 `zh-Hantasy`까지 번체 중국어로 판정됐다. 또 `zh-SG-` 접두가 빠져 정당한 `zh-SG-x-private`가 영어로 떨어졌다. 이 판정 코드는 네 개 파일에 각각 들어 있었고, 이제 네 곳 모두 접두 뒤에 분명한 경계를 요구한다. ⟦사전을 앞 두 글자만 보고 펼치면 `jar`로 시작하는 말이 한 칸에 몰린다. 이제는 단어 전체를 맞춰야 한다.⟧

items.original: **Language detection no longer misreads plain English words as Japanese or Korean, or a made-up Chinese-script tag as a real one.** The `_normalize_lang` logic — duplicated across four files — matched `ja`/`ko` with an unbounded `startswith`, so `jargon` and `koala` were read as Japanese and Korean; a POSIX `@modifier` suffix wasn't stripped, so `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English; and `zh-HK` didn't accept further BCP 47 subtags the way `zh-TW`/`zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant`/`zh-Hans` (letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese) and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix (dropping a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` tag to English). All four duplicated copies now require a boundary after every prefix.

title.zh-TW: 終端機編碼不合就整段訊息不見的問題修好了
title.zh-CN: 终端编码不合就整段消息不见的问题修好了

title.ja: 端末の文字コードが違うだけでメッセージが丸ごと消えなくなる
title.ko: 터미널 인코딩이 달라 메시지가 통째로 사라지던 문제를 고침

body.zh-TW: ⟦電線只要有一小段接觸不良，整條走廊的燈都熄掉；現在那截線路獨立起來，其餘照明不受影響。⟧工作階段開始與送出訊息時各有一個掛鉤，終端機用 cp950 這類非 UTF-8 編碼時，它們寫出 JSON 沒有轉成安全字元，會拋出 `UnicodeEncodeError`，你整段訊息就此消失。現在輸出一律轉成 ASCII 安全的 JSON，寫入動作也包在 `try`／`except OSError` 裡。另一個問題在版本標記：四個讀取器用 `split` 拆字串，遇到被截斷的一行或無效位元組就卡住，壞掉的腳本因此永遠不被認定需要重裝；現在改用 `partition`，也一併接住 `UnicodeDecodeError`。還有精簡模式的附屬檔內容爛掉時，只要掛鉤版本沒變就不會重建，因為判斷方式只是看檔案在不在；現在改成驗證內容本身。
body.zh-CN: ⟦电线只要有一小段接触不良，整条走廊的灯都熄掉；现在那截线路独立起来，其余照明不受影响。⟧会话开始与送出消息时各有一个挂钩，终端用 cp950 这类非 UTF-8 编码时，它们写出 JSON 没有转成安全字符，会抛出 `UnicodeEncodeError`，你整段消息就此消失。现在输出一律转成 ASCII 安全的 JSON，写入动作也包在 `try`／`except OSError` 里。另一个问题在版本标记：四个读取器用 `split` 拆字符串，遇到被截断的一行或无效字节就卡住，坏掉的脚本因此永远不被认定需要重装；现在改用 `partition`，也一并接住 `UnicodeDecodeError`。还有简洁模式的附属文件内容烂掉时，只要挂钩版本没变就不会重建，因为判断方式只是看文件在不在；现在改成验证内容本身。
body.en: ⟦One bad contact in the wiring used to darken the whole corridor; that stretch is now isolated, and the rest of the lights stay on.⟧ When a terminal uses a non-UTF-8 encoding such as cp950, `usage`'s hooks wrote JSON without escaping, raised `UnicodeEncodeError`, and lost your entire message. Output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON, with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. A second problem sat in the version marker: four readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, so a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. And when a terse-mode sidecar's content had rotted, it was never rebuilt as long as the hook version was unchanged, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it is now checked by validating the sidecar's content.
body.ja: ⟦配線の一か所が接触不良なだけで廊下の照明が全部消えていた。今はその区間が切り離され、残りの明かりは影響を受けない。⟧端末が cp950 のような非 UTF-8 の文字コードを使うと、`usage` のフックは変換せずに JSON を書き出し、`UnicodeEncodeError` を投げてメッセージが丸ごと失われていた。現在は出力を必ず ASCII で安全な JSON に変換し、書き込みも `try`／`except OSError` で包む。もう一つの問題はバージョン標識にある。四つの読み取り処理が `split` を使い、途中で切れた行や不正なバイトでつまずくため、壊れた導入済みスクリプトが再インストール対象と認識されなかった。今は `partition` を使い、`UnicodeDecodeError` も受け止める。さらに簡潔モードの付随ファイルは中身が壊れても、フックのバージョンが変わらない限り作り直されなかった。存在するかどうかだけで判定していたためで、今は中身そのものを検証する。
body.ko: ⟦배선 한 군데가 접촉이 나쁘다는 이유로 복도 조명이 전부 꺼졌다. 이제 그 구간이 따로 분리되어 나머지 불은 영향을 받지 않는다.⟧터미널이 cp950 같은 비 UTF-8 인코딩을 쓰면 `usage`의 훅이 변환 없이 JSON을 써서 `UnicodeEncodeError`가 나고 메시지가 통째로 사라졌다. 이제 출력은 반드시 ASCII로 안전한 JSON으로 바꾸고, 쓰기도 `try`／`except OSError`로 감싼다. 다른 문제는 버전 표식에 있었다. 네 개의 읽기 처리가 `split`을 써서 잘린 줄이나 잘못된 바이트에 걸렸고, 망가진 설치본이 재설치 대상으로 인식되지 못했다. 이제는 `partition`을 쓰고 `UnicodeDecodeError`도 함께 받아 낸다. 또 간결 모드의 딸림 파일은 내용이 망가져도 훅 버전이 그대로면 다시 만들어지지 않았다. 파일이 있는지만 보고 판단했기 때문이며, 이제는 내용 자체를 검증한다.

items.original: **A non-UTF-8 terminal no longer crashes terse mode or session resume, and a truncated or corrupted version marker no longer wedges self-heal.** The SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks wrote JSON without `ensure_ascii`, so a terminal using an encoding like cp950 raised `UnicodeEncodeError` and lost the entire message; output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. The four version-marker readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, which meant a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. Separately, a stale terse-mode sidecar whose content had rotted was never rebuilt as long as the hook version hadn't changed, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it's now checked by validating the sidecar's content.

title.zh-TW: 續接提示不再因為一個小錯就整段消失
title.zh-CN: 续接提示不再因为一个小错就整段消失

title.ja: 再開時の案内が小さな失敗一つで消えなくなる
title.ko: 이어가기 안내가 작은 실패 하나로 사라지지 않는다

body.zh-TW: ⟦一台機器只要有一個零件卡住就整台停擺；現在那個零件卡住時會單獨跳掉，機器照跑。⟧續接工作階段時 `usage` 會給你一段提示，講你上次做到哪。以前這段提示很容易整個不見：讀取標準輸入遇到管線斷掉會拋 `OSError`，但續接不像精簡模式那樣接住它，一個輸入輸出的小狀況就讓掛鉤當掉而不是正常結束。解析工作階段紀錄只接住 `OSError`，沒接 `UnicodeDecodeError`，紀錄裡有無效的 UTF-8 位元組時整段提示就消失，不會像遇到空紀錄那樣退回上一份還能用的舊紀錄。現在這兩種狀況都接住了，續接提示照樣出現。
body.zh-CN: ⟦一台机器只要有一个零件卡住就整台停摆；现在那个零件卡住时会单独跳掉，机器照跑。⟧续接会话时 `usage` 会给你一段提示，讲你上次做到哪。以前这段提示很容易整个不见：读取标准输入遇到管线断掉会抛 `OSError`，但续接不像简洁模式那样接住它，一个输入输出的小状况就让挂钩崩掉而不是正常结束。解析会话记录只接住 `OSError`，没接 `UnicodeDecodeError`，记录里有无效的 UTF-8 字节时整段提示就消失，不会像遇到空记录那样退回上一份还能用的旧记录。现在这两种状况都接住了，续接提示照样出现。
body.en: ⟦One jammed part used to stop the entire machine; now that part trips on its own and the machine keeps running.⟧ When you resume a session, `usage` gives you a prompt saying where you left off, and that prompt used to disappear whole. `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe and, unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume did not catch it, so an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt vanish instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did. Both are now caught, and the resume prompt still appears.
body.ja: ⟦部品が一つ引っ掛かるだけで機械全体が止まっていた。今はその部品だけが単独で外れ、機械は動き続ける。⟧セッションを再開すると、`usage` は前回どこまで進んだかを伝える案内を出す。以前はこの案内が丸ごと消えやすかった。標準入力の読み取りはパイプが切れると `OSError` を投げるが、再開処理は簡潔モードのようにそれを受け止めず、入出力の小さな不調でフックが落ちて正常終了しなかった。セッション記録の解析は `OSError` は受け止めても `UnicodeDecodeError` は受け止めず、不正な UTF-8 のバイトを含む記録があると案内全体が消え、空の記録のときのように一つ前の有効な記録へ下がることもなかった。今はどちらも受け止められ、再開の案内はそのまま出る。
body.ko: ⟦부품 하나가 걸렸다고 기계 전체가 멈췄다. 이제 그 부품만 따로 떨어져 나가고 기계는 계속 돈다.⟧세션을 이어갈 때 `usage`는 지난번에 어디까지 했는지 알려 주는 안내를 띄운다. 예전에는 이 안내가 통째로 사라지기 쉬웠다. 표준 입력 읽기는 파이프가 끊기면 `OSError`를 던지는데, 이어가기 처리는 간결 모드처럼 그것을 받아 내지 않아 작은 입출력 문제에도 훅이 죽고 정상 종료하지 못했다. 세션 기록 파싱은 `OSError`는 받아 냈지만 `UnicodeDecodeError`는 받지 못해, 잘못된 UTF-8 바이트가 든 기록이 있으면 안내 전체가 사라졌고, 빈 기록일 때처럼 바로 앞의 유효한 기록으로 물러나지도 않았다. 이제는 둘 다 받아 내어 이어가기 안내가 그대로 뜬다.

items.original: **Session resume's stdin and stdout failures are handled the same way its sibling hooks already were, and a corrupted newest session log falls back to an older one instead of going silent.** `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe, and unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume didn't catch it — an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. Separately, `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt disappear instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did.

title.zh-TW: 全部做完的待辦清單會清掉，只回一個標點不算數
title.zh-CN: 全部做完的待办清单会清掉，只回一个标点不算数
title.en: A finished todo list gets cleared, and a lone punctuation reply does not count
title.ja: すべて終えた作業リストは消え、記号だけの返信は本文と見なされない
title.ko: 전부 끝난 할 일 목록은 지워지고, 기호뿐인 답은 본문으로 치지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 上次的事情都做完了，下次續接時提示還在報那些已完成的工作。續接掛鉤只有在新清單非空時才覆蓋舊的，而一次工作階段最後那筆 `TodoWrite`，也就是把每項都標成完成、留下空清單的那一筆，就被忽略了。現在全部項目標記完成後，清單會被清掉。同一批還修了三件事。健康檢查提醒存去重狀態時碰上磁碟滿了或權限不足，錯誤會往外冒把續接提示一起吞掉；現在用 `contextlib.suppress(OSError)` 框住。判斷回覆有沒有實質內容時，只要文字裡有標點就算數，`ok.` 或 `/clear` 這種短回覆因此被留下；現在要求標點兩側都得有字母或數字。另外，`git status` 給未追蹤目錄的路徑帶著結尾斜線，取檔名得到空字串被默默丟掉，剛建好還沒提交的資料夾因此沒出現在未提交清單裡。⟦清單上每格都打了勾，整張才收走；旁邊只畫了一撇的那格不算填過。⟧
body.zh-CN: 上次的事情都做完了，下次续接时提示还在报那些已完成的工作。续接挂钩只有在新清单非空时才覆盖旧的，而一次会话最后那笔 `TodoWrite`，也就是把每项都标成完成、留下空清单的那一笔，就被忽略了。现在全部项目标记完成后，清单会被清掉。同一批还修了三件事。健康检查提醒存自己的去重状态时若碰上磁盘满了或权限不足，那个错误会一路往外冒，把主要的续接提示一起吞掉；现在用 `contextlib.suppress(OSError)` 框住。判断回复有没有实质内容时，只要文字里有任何标点就算数，于是 `ok.` 或 `/clear` 这种短回复被留了下来，现在要求标点两侧都得有字母或数字。另外，`git status` 给未跟踪目录的路径带着结尾斜线，取文件名得到空字符串被默默丢掉，刚建好还没提交的文件夹因此没出现在未提交清单里。⟦清单上每格都打了勾，整张才收走；旁边只画了一撇的那格不算填过。⟧
body.en: Everything from last time was finished, yet the next resume prompt kept reporting that work. The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored. A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done. Three more fixes landed alongside it. Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` on a full disk or a permissions error, and that exception propagated far enough to swallow the main resume prompt; it is now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary. ⟦Only when every box on the sheet is ticked does the sheet get taken away; a stray stroke beside a box does not count as filled in.⟧
body.ja: 前回の作業はすべて終えたはずなのに、次の再開案内が終わった仕事を報告し続けていた。再開フックは新しいリストが空でないときだけ保存済みリストを上書きしていたため、セッション最後の `TodoWrite`、つまり全項目を完了に印して空のリストを残す呼び出しが無視されていた。今は全項目が完了になった時点でリストが消える。同じ回で三点も直った。健康チェックの重複防止状態を保存する際にディスク不足や権限エラーが起きると、その例外が外まで伝わって主要な再開の案内ごと飲み込んでいた。今は `contextlib.suppress(OSError)` で囲っている。返信に実質的な内容があるかの判定は、文中のどこかに記号があるだけで内容ありと見なしていたため、`ok.` や `/clear` のような短い返信が残っていた。今は記号の両側に英数字があることを求める。また `git status` が未追跡ディレクトリのパス末尾に付ける斜線のせいでファイル名の取得が空文字となり、黙って捨てられていた。作ったばかりで未コミットのフォルダが一覧に出なかったのはこのためである。⟦用紙のすべての枠にチェックが入って初めて用紙が回収される。枠の脇の走り書きは記入と見なさない。⟧
body.ko: 지난번 일은 다 끝냈는데도 다음 이어가기 안내가 끝난 작업을 계속 알려 줬다. 이어가기 훅이 새 목록이 비어 있지 않을 때만 저장된 목록을 덮어썼기 때문에, 세션 마지막의 `TodoWrite`, 곧 모든 항목을 완료로 표시해 빈 목록을 남기는 호출이 무시됐다. 이제 모든 항목이 완료로 표시되면 목록이 지워진다. 같은 회차에 세 가지가 더 고쳐졌다. 건강 점검 알림의 중복 방지 상태를 저장하다 디스크가 꽉 차거나 권한 오류가 나면 그 예외가 바깥까지 번져 주요 이어가기 안내까지 삼켰다. 이제는 `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`로 감쌌다. 답에 실질적인 내용이 있는지 판단할 때 글 안 어디든 기호가 있기만 하면 내용이 있다고 봐서 `ok.`나 `/clear` 같은 짧은 답이 남았다. 이제는 기호 양쪽에 영문자나 숫자가 있어야 한다고 요구한다. 또 `git status`가 추적되지 않은 디렉터리 경로 끝에 붙이는 빗금 때문에 파일 이름을 얻으면 빈 문자열이 되어 조용히 버려졌다. 막 만들고 커밋하지 않은 폴더가 목록에 나오지 않던 이유가 이것이다. ⟦용지의 모든 칸에 체크가 들어가야 용지를 걷어 간다. 칸 옆에 그은 획 하나는 기입으로 치지 않는다.⟧

items.original:
**A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done.** The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored, and the next session's resume prompt kept reporting work that was already finished.
**The health-check reminder's own state write no longer takes the whole resume prompt down with it, a bare punctuation reply is no longer read as a real request, and a newly created but uncommitted directory now shows up in the "not saved yet" list.** Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` (a full disk, a permissions error) and that exception propagated out far enough to swallow the main resume prompt along with it; it's now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. Separately, `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary.

title.zh-TW: 額度回復的通知回來了，一開啟就超標也會提醒
title.zh-CN: 额度恢复的通知回来了，一开启就超标也会提醒
title.en: The quota-restored notification is back, and a first reading past the threshold warns
title.ja: 残量回復の通知が復活し、起動直後に超えていても警告が出る
title.ko: 잔량 회복 알림이 돌아오고, 켜자마자 기준을 넘었어도 경고한다

body.zh-TW: ⟦油表警示燈只要指針稍微晃回來就自己熄掉，等真的加滿油了反而沒有任何提示；而上車時油量本來就見底，它也一聲不吭。⟧額度用完後回復時，`usage` 應該通知你，實際上這則通知一直沒出現。原因是任何低於 100% 的讀數都會把「曾經用完」這個記號清掉，不管跌幅多小；等到真正的重置被認出來，記號早就被先前的小波動清掉了。那個重置指的是一次夠大的單步下降，用來跟雜訊區分開。現在只有那個重置判斷本身會清掉它。另外，警告門檻以前只能靠跟前一筆讀數比較才跨得過去，所以第一次觀測就已經超過門檻的情況完全不會警告，例如程式在你的工作階段進行到 95% 時才啟動。這不像用完的通知，那個第一次讀到 100% 就一定會發。
body.zh-CN: ⟦油表警示灯只要指针稍微晃回来就自己熄掉，等真的加满油了反而没有任何提示；而上车时油量本来就见底，它也一声不吭。⟧额度用完后恢复时，`usage` 应该通知你，实际上这则通知一直没出现。原因是任何低于 100% 的读数都会把「曾经用完」这个记号清掉，不管跌幅多小；等到真正的重置被认出来，记号早就被先前的小波动清掉了。那个重置指的是一次够大的单步下降，用来跟噪声区分开。现在只有那个重置判断本身会清掉它。另外，警告门槛以前只能靠跟前一笔读数比较才跨得过去，所以第一次观测就已经超过门槛的情况完全不会警告，例如程序在你的会话进行到 95% 时才启动。这不像用完的通知，那个第一次读到 100% 就一定会发。
body.en: ⟦A fuel warning light that goes out the moment the needle twitches back says nothing when the tank is actually refilled, and stays silent when you get in with the tank already low.⟧ `usage` is supposed to tell you when depleted quota comes back, and that notification never fired. Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation. It is now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — the app launching mid-session at 95%, for instance — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.
body.ja: ⟦燃料の警告灯が針の少しの揺り戻しで消えてしまうと、実際に満タンにしても何も知らせず、乗り込んだ時点で既に残り少なくても黙ったままになる。⟧使い切った残量が戻ったとき、`usage` は通知するはずだったが、その通知はずっと出ていなかった。100% を下回る読み取りは、下げ幅がどれほど小さくても「使い切った」という印を消していたためである。本物のリセットが検出される頃には、つまり雑音と区別できるだけの大きな一段の下降が来る頃には、印は先の小さな揺らぎで既に消えていた。今はそのリセット検出だけが印を消す。また警告のしきい値は前回の読み取りとの比較でしか超えられなかったため、最初の観測時点で既にしきい値を超えている場合、たとえば 95% の時点でアプリが起動した場合には警告が出なかった。100% を最初に読んだ時点で必ず発火する使い切りの通知とは対照的である。
body.ko: ⟦연료 경고등이 바늘이 조금 되돌아왔다고 꺼져 버리면, 실제로 가득 채워도 아무 말이 없고 탈 때부터 이미 바닥이어도 조용하다.⟧다 쓴 잔량이 회복되면 `usage`가 알려 줘야 하는데, 그 알림이 계속 뜨지 않았다. 100% 아래의 어떤 읽기든, 떨어진 폭이 아무리 작아도 「다 썼음」 표시를 지웠기 때문이다. 진짜 초기화가 감지될 무렵, 곧 잡음과 구분될 만큼 큰 한 단계 하락이 올 무렵에는 그 표시가 앞선 작은 흔들림에 이미 지워져 있었다. 이제는 그 초기화 감지만이 표시를 지운다. 또 경고 기준은 이전 읽기와 비교해야만 넘을 수 있어서, 첫 관측 때 이미 기준을 넘은 경우, 예컨대 95%인 시점에 앱이 켜진 경우에는 경고가 전혀 없었다. 처음 100%를 읽으면 반드시 발생하는 소진 알림과는 달랐다.

items.original: **The quota-restored notification fires again, and a warning now fires on the very first reading if quota is already past the threshold.** Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation, and the restored notification never fired. It's now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — for instance, the app launching mid-session at 95% — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.

title.zh-TW: 系統匣選單不再被一個讀取失敗整個拖垮
title.zh-CN: 系统托盘菜单不再被一个读取失败整个拖垮
title.en: One registry read failure no longer takes down the tray menu
title.ja: レジストリの読み取り失敗でトレイメニュー全体が落ちなくなる
title.ko: 레지스트리 읽기 실패로 트레이 메뉴 전체가 죽지 않는다

body.zh-TW: Windows 上點開選單列的圖示，整個系統匣選單可能整個壞掉打不開。壞的其實只有一列：畫「開機時啟動」那個勾選框時，程式要去讀登錄檔（registry，Windows 存放系統與程式設定的資料庫）確認狀態，而它只接住找不到檔案這一種錯誤。權限不足時錯誤就往外冒，整份系統匣選單跟著垮。現在它接住所有 `OSError`，那一列直接顯示為未啟用。同一批也清掉一個沒有作用的設定鍵 `StartDelay`。`launchd.plist(5)` 根本不認得它，從加進去那天起就沒起過任何作用。⟦儀表板上一顆燈的線路壞了，整片儀表就黑掉；現在那顆燈只顯示未亮，其他讀數照常。⟧
body.zh-CN: Windows 上点开菜单栏的图标，整个系统托盘菜单可能整个坏掉打不开。坏的其实只有一列：画「开机时启动」那个勾选框时，程序要去读注册表（registry，Windows 存放系统与程序设置的数据库）确认状态，而它只接住找不到文件这一种错误。权限不足时错误就往外冒，整份系统托盘菜单跟着垮。现在它接住所有 `OSError`，那一列直接显示为未启用。同一批也清掉一个没有作用的设置键 `StartDelay`。`launchd.plist(5)` 根本不认得它，从加进去那天起就没起过任何作用。⟦仪表板上一颗灯的线路坏了，整片仪表就黑掉；现在那颗灯只显示未亮，其他读数照常。⟧
body.en: On Windows, clicking the menu bar icon could leave the whole tray menu broken. Only one row was actually at fault: to draw the "launch at login" checkbox, the app reads the registry, the database where Windows keeps system and program settings, and its `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`. A registry permission error therefore propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled." The same batch removed a dead settings key, `StartDelay`: `launchd.plist(5)` does not recognize it, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added. ⟦When the wiring behind one dashboard lamp failed, the entire panel went dark; now that lamp simply shows unlit and the other readings stay up.⟧
body.ja: Windows でメニューバーのアイコンを押すと、トレイメニュー全体が壊れて開かないことがあった。実際に不調なのは一行だけである。「ログイン時に起動」のチェックボックスを描くために、アプリはレジストリ、つまり Windows が設定を保管するデータベースを読みに行くが、その処理はファイルが見つからない場合しか受け止めていなかった。権限のエラーはそのまま外へ伝わり、その一行だけでなくメニュー全体を壊し得た。今はあらゆる `OSError` を受け止め、その行を「未有効」と表示する。同じ回で効果のない設定キー `StartDelay` も削除された。`launchd.plist(5)` はこのキーを認識しないため、追加された日から何の働きもしていなかった。⟦計器盤のランプ一つの配線が壊れただけで盤面全体が暗転していた。今はそのランプが消灯と表示されるだけで、他の数値は出続ける。⟧
body.ko: Windows에서 메뉴 막대 아이콘을 눌렀을 때 트레이 메뉴 전체가 망가져 열리지 않는 일이 있었다. 실제로 문제가 있는 것은 한 줄뿐이다. 「로그인 시 실행」 체크박스를 그리려고 앱이 레지스트리, 곧 Windows가 설정을 보관하는 데이터베이스를 읽는데, 그 처리는 파일을 찾지 못한 경우만 받아 냈다. 권한 오류는 그대로 바깥으로 번져 그 한 줄이 아니라 메뉴 전체를 망가뜨릴 수 있었다. 이제는 모든 `OSError`를 받아 내고 그 줄을 「사용 안 함」으로 표시한다. 같은 회차에 효과 없는 설정 키 `StartDelay`도 지워졌다. `launchd.plist(5)`가 이 키를 알아보지 못해, 추가된 날부터 아무 일도 하지 않았다. ⟦계기판 램프 하나의 배선이 망가졌다고 판 전체가 꺼졌다. 이제 그 램프만 꺼짐으로 표시되고 다른 수치는 계속 나온다.⟧

items.original: **A dead plist key was removed, and a Windows registry read failure can no longer take down the whole tray menu.** `StartDelay` isn't a key `launchd.plist(5)` recognizes, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added; it's gone. Separately, the Windows login-item's `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`, but it's called once per menu render to draw the "launch at login" checkbox — a registry permission error there propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled."

body.ko: ⟦안내인이 내내 알아듣기 쉬운 말로 설명하다가 현지 화자의 한 대목만 그대로 옮겨 읽어 청중을 놓친다. 이제 그 대목도 같은 쉬운 말로 다시 전한다.⟧간결 모드는 쉬운 말을 요구하지만, 이 규칙은 예전에 Claude가 직접 쓴 문장만 다뤘다. 서브에이전트의 보고나 도구의 원본 출력을 그대로 인용할 때는 모드의 지시에 아무 내용이 없어, 그 안의 전문 용어가 설명 없이 붙었다. 이번에 기존의 「용어는 처음 나올 때 설명한다」 규칙 뒤에 한 줄이 추가됐다. 다섯 언어 모두에 들어갔다.

items.original: **Terse mode's plain-language rule now also covers text pasted verbatim from a subagent.** The mode's own prompt only governed sentences Claude wrote itself, leaving no instruction for handling a subagent's report or a tool's raw output when quoted directly — jargon inside it went unexplained. A line was added after the existing "explain a term on first use" rule, in all five languages.

## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
body.ja:
⟦現像した写真を日誌に一枚ずつ貼っていく。ページに「ここに写真」と書いてあればその場所に重ねて貼り、書いていないページには末尾に足す。⟧不具合を報告するときにスクリーンショットを添えたければ、以前はウェブを開いて先にアップロードする必要があった。`gh` に `--attach` が加わり、ローカルの画像や動画をアップロードして issue、pull request、コメントの本文に差し込めるようになった。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

本文がそのローカルパスをすでに参照していれば、`gh` はアップロード後の URL に差し替える。参照していなければ末尾に追加する。一度の実行で複数のファイルを添えるには、このフラグを繰り返し書く。この機能は GitHub.com と GitHub Enterprise Cloud で使える。
body.ko:
⟦인화한 사진을 일지에 한 장씩 붙인다. 「여기에 사진」이라고 적힌 자리가 있으면 그 위에 덮어 붙이고, 없는 쪽에는 끝에 이어 붙인다.⟧문제를 알릴 때 스크린샷을 붙이려면 예전에는 웹을 열어 먼저 올려야 했다. 이제 `gh`에 `--attach`가 생겨, 로컬의 이미지와 동영상을 올려 issue, pull request, 댓글 본문에 넣을 수 있다.

```shell

gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

본문이 그 로컬 경로를 이미 가리키고 있으면 `gh`가 올린 뒤의 주소로 바꿔 넣고, 그렇지 않으면 끝에 덧붙인다. 한 번의 실행으로 여러 파일을 붙이려면 이 플래그를 여러 번 적는다. 이 기능은 GitHub.com과 GitHub Enterprise Cloud에서 쓸 수 있다.

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.zh-CN: `gh issue develop` 能另开工作目录，手上的东西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree
title.ja: `gh issue develop` が別のワークツリーにチェックアウトできる
title.ko: `gh issue develop` 이 별도 워크트리로 체크아웃할 수 있다

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.zh-CN:
手边的改动改到一半，issue 那头又要你开一条新分支——以前得先收拾现场才能切过去。现在 `gh issue develop` 可以帮 issue 建好联动的分支，并且把它签出到一个新的 Git worktree（工作树，让同一项目平行开多份副本的功能），你目前这份工作目录原封不动。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要赶另一项工程时，不必把现场拆掉重排，而是在旁边另辟一块作业区，两边同时进行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧
body.ja:
手元の変更が途中なのに issue の側で新しいブランチが必要になると、以前は片付けてからでないと切り替えられなかった。`gh issue develop` は issue に紐づくブランチを作り、新しい Git worktree にチェックアウトできるようになった。worktree とは、同じプロジェクトをもう一つ別の作業ディレクトリとして開き、互いに独立させる仕組みである。いま開いている作業コピーはそのまま残る。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦現場が別の工事も進める際、すでに組んだものを崩して並べ直すのではなく、隣に作業区画をもう一つ開いて同時に進めるようなものである。⟧
body.ko:
손대던 작업이 아직 중간인데 issue 쪽에서 새 브랜치가 필요해지면, 예전에는 정리부터 해야 옮겨 갈 수 있었다. 이제 `gh issue develop`이 issue에 연결된 브랜치를 만들고 새 Git worktree로 체크아웃할 수 있다. worktree는 같은 프로젝트를 또 하나의 작업 디렉터리로 열어 서로 독립시키는 방식이다. 지금 쓰던 작업 사본은 그대로 남는다.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦현장이 다른 공사도 진행해야 할 때, 이미 깔아 둔 것을 헐어 다시 배치하지 않고 옆에 작업 구역을 하나 더 열어 동시에 진행하는 것과 같다.⟧
